## Problem / Problema
What user problem does this solve? / ¿Qué problema resuelve?

## Proposed behavior / Solución propuesta
Describe observable expected behavior.

## Reproduction or example / Ejemplo
Use **fake data only**.

## Acceptance criteria / Criterios
- [ ] Function can be tested locally
- [ ] Documentation in English or Spanish
- [ ] No production API keys, personal data or copyrighted proprietary assets

## Would you contribute a PR? / ¿Quieres enviar un PR?
